nomenclature_corrections.F5.three_way_after_nine_innings: Misnamed GENERIC key; this F5 distribution refers to FIRST FIVE INNINGS and is not nine-inning data.
nomenclature_corrections.full_9_in: Misleading scope name: mechanical 'full' μ targets REGULAR-SEASON FINAL RUNS, and underlying final totals can include extra innings. It is NOT a separately estimated nine-inning regulatory score process.
nomenclature_corrections.full_9_in.three_way_after_nine_innings: Derived hypothetical full-score split under independent negative-binomial marginals; not an exact 9-inning tie forecast and not the actual official/extra-inning bookmaker settlement probabilities.
nomenclature_corrections.full_9_in.baseball_win_one_loss_after_ni: Derived 2+/≤1/2+ margin on model full-run scores, not validated for the final official win-one-loss product.
